svg.text: INTERLOCK SCHEDULE (SIS ON THE PLC · C&E 2407-IN-CE-001 A2)
ON ANY TRIP (COMMON SHUTDOWN, OTS sisTrip):
CLOSE XV-101, XV-201, XV-301 · FV-101 / FV-201 TO 0 % · STOP P-301
OPEN XV-401 AND FV-401 100 % (N₂ PURGE) · E-601 AND E1/E2/E3 OFF*
ALL FIC/TIC TO MAN, OUTPUT 0 · XV-601/602 PER COLUMN: C CLOSE,
O OPEN, - NO ACTION · XV-603: O = OPEN (DEPRESSURE TO CV).
ARM: A = ALWAYS · R = RUN ONLY (BYPASSED IN READY FOR START-UP).
RESET: TRIPPED → READY BY OPERATOR WHEN NO "A" TRIP IS ACTIVE;
READY → RUN ("ARM") ONLY WITH ALL PERMISSIVES:
XV-603 CLOSE BLOCKED BELOW 2 barg AIR (FAILS OPEN).
ALL PSVs: INLET BV LO; BYPASS BV NC + NV; NO OUTLET ISOLATION (NOTE 14, SHT 1).
20. AT DESIGN: E-602 OUTLET TT-609 30.4 °C, DUTY 1.06 kW OF 5.3 kW RATED; CHILLED WATER 67.0 L/min
LIQUID TO T-601 69.3 mL/min (MeOH 1.69 wt%). OTS ALARM LIMITS FROM ALM; TRIP SETTINGS FROM TRIPS / K.
21. LIC-601 / LIC-602 ARE ON/OFF: XV-601 OPENS AT 50 %, CLOSES AT 40 %; XV-602 OPENS AT 50 %,
CLOSES AT 25 %. XV-601 IS ALSO THE LALL-601 TRIP VALVE (SHARED FINAL ELEMENT): HOLD.
22. LALL/LAHH-601 AND -602 USE THE CONTROL TRANSMITTERS LT-601/602; TAHH-601 USES TT-601
(TIC-601 PV). LAHH-605 (LS-605) IS INDEPENDENT. SEPARATE SIS SENSORS: HOLD (NOTE 5).
23. XV-603 DEPRESSURES THROUGH BV-645 / PR-601 / BV-621 AS ON P&ID A6; THE OTS VENTS DIRECT: TBC.
24. E-602 TUBE (PROCESS) DESIGN 33 barg (EQL A1) IS BELOW THE 36 barg SET OF PSV-601/603
AND EQUAL TO PAHH-601/608 (33 barg): HOLD.
25. BV-622 APPEARS TWICE IN INL R4 (PSV-602 AND PSV-606 BYPASS); THE BPV-602 BYPASS VALVE
IS BV-627 AND THE PSV-606 BYPASS IS BV-646 / NV-611 (NEW NUMBERS): HOLD.
26. GC AT-610 WITH AI-610…613 (H₂, CO₂, CO, N₂ DRY %%) AS IN THE OTS; GC CYCLE 4 min (ASSUMED).
27. T-601: 2 SHELLS (EQL); LG-601 C/W BV-641/642 NOT SHOWN. T-601 DESIGN ATM vs PSV-604 2 barg: TBC.
28. COLD-VENT HEADER / VS-601 SIZE HOLD (RELIEF LOADS IN THE SCHEDULE); NO GAS DETECTION OR
FLAME ARRESTER IN THE DOCUMENTS: TBC. SEAL-POT DRAIN BV-644 (P&ID A6) NOT SHOWN.
29. FAIL POSITIONS ON LOSS OF AIR (PT-902 < 2 barg): XV-601/602 CLOSE, XV-603 OPENS. FT-701 TYPE TBD.
